description: Use this when someone wants to save, share, or keep working on a plan from a public guide or itinerary. Returns the WonderKit web links for that city guide, itinerary, and the guest planner. This server cannot save or share anything itself.

city.description: City name or WonderKit city key, such as "Paris" or "paris-france".

slug.description: Optional itinerary slug to link a specific public plan.

name: continue_in_wonderkit

found.description: false when the lookup did not resolve

matches.description: Candidate cities when the name is ambiguous

nearest.description: Covered cities in or near the asked-for area. Not the city that was asked for

url.description: The WonderKit page for this city

why.description: Why this city is offered, e.g. "in Vermont" or "near Wyoming"

planDescription.description: One line saying what planUrl opens

planUrl.description: Guest planner link for the destination as asked; it plans any city

reason.description: unknown_city, region_not_city, no_city_guide, no_itineraries_for_city, ambiguous_city, no_published_guide, no_matches, unknown_itinerary, lookup_failed, …

region.description: The state, country, or area the city ask was read as

suggestions.description: Near-miss spellings, or same-name cities elsewhere, when the name is unknown

title: Continue in WonderKit
